content.text:
Map the provided canvas’s diagram nodes to the source-code line ranges that explain or implement them.

Inspect the source code and choose the smallest meaningful ranges that support each node. A node may map to multiple ranges across multiple files. Leave nodes unmapped when you cannot find supporting code.

Register the mappings, preserving every diagram’s content and the canvas layout.

Inputs and submission: the saved AgentContext contains the pinned repository checkout and diagram-data.json (ASCII and node references). Use the available read/bash tools to inspect that checkout. No layout template or examples are used. Return only JSON: {"diagrams":[{"diagramId":"d1","mappings":[{"node":"n1","path":"relative/file.ts","startLine":10,"endLine":20}]}],"notes":"Any unsupported nodes or uncertainty"}. Include every supplied diagram, using an empty mappings array if needed. Each entry maps one supplied node reference to one repository-relative, 1-based inclusive source range; repeat the node for multiple ranges. Do not change diagram text or layout.

The runner registers these exact node/range choices through the setSourceMappings operation underlying nodes.setSourceMappings. It resolves the supplied node references to their current diagram spans and fills evidence.originalLines from the pinned source. It does not choose, widen or repair source ranges. The checkout is read-only; no canvas tools are exposed inside this evaluation session.

Before submission, read each selected range with line numbers that restart for that file (for example, nl -ba one-file.ts). Do not infer range endpoints from search hits or use cumulative numbering across files. Call validate_source_mappings with your complete candidate JSON, inspect any reported errors, and verify corrected ranges against the source before returning the final JSON. The final JSON must match a candidate that passed this check. This tool checks node references, file existence and line bounds; semantic support still requires your inspection. Validation calls and any within-session corrections are retained as part of the same sample; they are not separate generation attempts.

    55	export const layer = Layer.effect(
    56	  Service,
    57	  Effect.gen(function* () {
    58	    const store = yield* SessionStore.Service
    59	    const instances = yield* Instance.Service
    60	    const bus = yield* Bus.Service
    61	    const jobs = yield* Job.Service
    62	    const inbox = yield* SessionInbox.Service
    63	    const db = (yield* Database.Service).db
    64	    const reportLifecycle = <A>(sessionID: SessionSchema.ID, effect: Effect.Effect<A>) =>
    65	      effect.pipe(
    66	        Effect.tapCause((cause) =>
    67	          Cause.hasInterruptsOnly(cause)
    68	            ? Effect.void
    69	            : Effect.logError("Failed to publish Session execution lifecycle", cause).pipe(
    70	                Effect.annotateLogs({ sessionID }),
    71	              ),
    72	        ),
    73	        Effect.asVoid,
    74	      )
    75	    // Write-ahead claim: starting records the durable intent that a turn is in flight, in the same
    76	    // transaction as the started event. Terminals release it — except shutdown interruption, which
    77	    // preserves the claim so the next server start resumes the turn. A claim that survives with no
    78	    // terminal is the signature of a process that died without teardown (crash, SIGKILL, eviction);
    79	    // recovery is a property of the database, never of a shutdown hook that may not run.
    80	    const claimOnCommit = (sessionID: SessionSchema.ID) => ({
    81	      commit: () => store.claim(sessionID),
    82	    })
    83	    // The report coordinator is built first so the run coordinator's hooks can use it, while its
    84	    // wake and draining dependencies bind late to the coordinator the hooks belong to.
    85	    const holder: {
    86	      coordinator?: SessionRunCoordinator.Coordinator<SessionSchema.ID, SessionRunner.RunError, InterruptReason>
    87	    } = {}
    88	    const subagentReport = SubagentReport.make({
    89	      store,
    90	      jobs,
    91	      inbox,
    92	      wake: (sessionID) =>
    93	        Effect.suspend(() => (holder.coordinator ? holder.coordinator.wake(sessionID) : Effect.void)),
    94	      draining: Effect.suspend<ReadonlySet<SessionSchema.ID>, never, never>(() =>
    95	        holder.coordinator ? holder.coordinator.draining : Effect.succeed(new Set<SessionSchema.ID>()),
    96	      ),
    97	    })
    98	    // Why a Session's execution is being interrupted, read from the coordinator once it exists.
    99	    let interruption: (sessionID: SessionSchema.ID) => InterruptReason | undefined = () => undefined
   100	    const drain = Effect.fnUntraced(function* (
   101	      sessionID: SessionSchema.ID,
   102	      force: boolean,
   103	      continuation?: SessionRunner.Continuation,
   104	      promotable: SessionInbox.Promotable = "input",
   105	      stepped = false,
   106	    ): Effect.fn.Return<void, SessionRunner.RunError> {
   107	      const session = yield* store.get(sessionID)
   108	      if (!session) return yield* Effect.die(new Error(`Session not found: ${sessionID}`))
   109	      const result = yield* SessionRunner.Service.use((runner) =>
   110	        runner.drain({
   111	          sessionID,
   112	          force,
   113	          continuation,
   114	          promotable,
   115	          stepped,
   116	          interruption: () => interruption(sessionID),
   117	        }),
   118	      ).pipe(
   119	        instances.provide(session),
   120	        Effect.tapCause((cause) =>
   121	          Cause.hasInterruptsOnly(cause)
   122	            ? Effect.void
   123	            : Effect.logError("Failed to drain Session", cause).pipe(Effect.annotateLogs({ sessionID })),
   124	        ),
   125	      )
   126	      return yield* SessionRunner.DrainResult.$match(result, {
   127	        Complete: () => Effect.void,
   128	        Moved: (result) => drain(sessionID, false, result.continuation, promotable, result.stepped),
   129	        Reloaded: (result) => drain(sessionID, result.force, result.continuation, promotable, result.stepped),
   130	      })
   131	    })
   132	    const coordinator = yield* SessionRunCoordinator.make<SessionSchema.ID, SessionRunner.RunError, InterruptReason>({
   133	      started: (sessionID) =>
   134	        reportLifecycle(
   135	          sessionID,
   136	          Effect.gen(function* () {
   137	            // Bind before the started publication yields to SQLite so a cancel arriving during
   138	            // that window still matches this generation.
   139	            const before = yield* jobs.currentGeneration(sessionID)
   140	            const event = yield* bus.publish(SessionEvent.Execution.Started, { sessionID }, claimOnCommit(sessionID))
   141	            const bound = before?.running ? before : yield* jobs.currentGeneration(sessionID)
   142	            subagentReport.started(sessionID, {
   143	              startedSeq: event.durable.seq,
   144	              boundGeneration: bound?.running ? bound.generation : undefined,
   145	            })
   146	          }),
   147	        ),
   148	      drain: (sessionID, force, promotable) => drain(sessionID, force, undefined, promotable),
   149	      // One terminal observation per busy period, covering every coalesced drain.
   150	      settled: (sessionID, exit, reason) =>
   151	        reportLifecycle(
   152	          sessionID,
   153	          Effect.gen(function* () {
   154	            const outcome = terminal(exit, reason)
   155	            if (outcome.type === "interrupted" && outcome.reason === "shutdown") {
   156	              subagentReport.clear(sessionID)
   157	              // Shutdown keeps the claim and the running Job row for restart continuity.
   158	              yield* bus.publish(SessionEvent.Execution.Interrupted, { sessionID, reason: "shutdown" })
   159	              return
   160	            }
   161	            // Claim the Job generation before cancelling it so the settlement commit owns its outbox row.
   162	            const settlement = yield* subagentReport.prepare(sessionID, outcome)
   163	            if (outcome.type === "interrupted") yield* jobs.cancel(sessionID)

   166	            // next restart, and a delivery defect must not fail the settled hook.
   167	            yield* settlement.deliver.pipe(
   168	              Effect.ignoreCause({ log: "Error", message: "Subagent report delivery failed" }),
   169	            )
   170	          }),
   171	        ),
   172	    })

   174	
   175	    interruption = coordinator.interruption

   177	      active: coordinator.active,
   178	      isActive: coordinator.isActive,
   179	      interrupt: (sessionID, options) =>
   180	        Effect.gen(function* () {
   181	          const interrupted = yield* coordinator.interrupt(sessionID, "user")
   182	          if (!options?.resume) return interrupted
   183	          // Resume steering input and between-turn control work from the interrupted
   184	          // intent. Queued next-turn prompts stay parked: a steer-scoped drain never
   185	          // promotes them, and a control item behind a queued prompt waits its turn.
   186	          // Interruption acknowledges before cleanup settles, so this wake usually lands
   187	          // on the stopping execution's doorbell and starts the successor at settle.
   188	          // Reading the inbox concurrently with the dying drain is safe: delivery consumes
   189	          // rows inside uninterruptible publications, so a steer row is either still
   190	          // promotable here or was fully delivered and needs no resumption.

   193	          if (next.delivery === "steer" || next.type === "compaction" || next.type === "move")
   194	            yield* coordinator.wake(sessionID, "steer")
   195	          return interrupted
   196	        }),

    38	/** Normalize equivalent placements before they become resource-cache keys. */
    39	export function canonical(ref: Location.Ref) {
    40	  // Workspace refs can hold remote POSIX paths even on a Windows host.
    41	  const flavor = process.platform === "win32" && !ref.directory.startsWith("/") ? path.win32 : path.posix
    42	  const normalized = flavor.normalize(ref.directory)
    43	  const trailing = normalized.endsWith(flavor.sep) && normalized.length > flavor.parse(normalized).root.length
    44	  return Location.Ref.make({
    45	    directory: AbsolutePath.make(trailing ? normalized.slice(0, -1) : normalized),
    46	    workspaceID: ref.workspaceID,
    47	  })
    48	}
